Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-10T04:55Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Lane:** `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, the generated references and `skills/objectstack-ui`. That is `domain:spec`, and the `skills/**` edit takes the maintainer's APPROVED review (Tier H), as the card says.
- **Why p1:** the default flips on the v18 line, so it must ride the v18 release. After 18.0 it would be a second behaviour change in a minor (发版本优先的都 p1).
- **Direction:** as filed, from the maintainer's 「乙 v18 把 spec 默认翻成 true,editInline: false 变成关法。」 ⛔ No app-level default. The permission gate is unchanged.
- **The consumer half is objectui's.** The claiming seat files it as the contract-first follow-up, with `Blocked-by:` this card. It reads `editInline !== false` and needs no new export from `@objectstack/spec`. Its landing waits for this card, not for the install face. In the window, objectui still reads an absent key as off, so nothing regresses.

Claim: PM loop round 5 (#22605, the maintainer's ruling 乙: `ListView.userActions.editInline` defaults to `true` on the v18 line, and `editInline: false` is the opt-out) · 2026-10-10T05:33Z

Domain: `domain:spec`
Seat: `domain:spec#3` (seat post #18883)
File surface (at `origin/main` `d748ae80af` or later; stop on breach and explain in the report). **Two PRs**, because the card's `skills/**` paragraph is Tier H and the default flip must not wait on it:
- **PR 1 (`Part of #22605`, the queue):**
  - `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (about `:1535`): `editInline: z.boolean().default(true)`, with the `describe` text rewritten as the card states;
  - the reference pages through their generator (`content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx`, `page.mdx`) and any other generated artifact the default renders into;
  - the ADR-0087 disposition `check:adr-0087-registration` demands for a default flip (a D3 entry and its regenerated registry, if that is what it demands);
  - `.changeset/22605-*.md` (`@objectstack/spec`; `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, with the launch-window BREAKING banner naming the author who relied on the documented default for a read-only list, and the remedy `editInline: false`);
  - pins in `packages/spec/src/ui/`.
- **PR 2 (`Fixes #22605`, Tier H, the maintainer's APPROVED review):** `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md`, "Configuring a List View", one paragraph as the card states, through the skill's generator if it has one.
- ⛔ No app-level default. ⛔ The permission gate is untouched. ⛔ Nothing in objectui: its consumer half is filed in this act as the contract-first follow-up.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` — MANDATORY: `dispatch-gates --tier` on `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` prints "Model tier — MANDATORY: … (derived from the file surface, not recalled)" for `'skills/**'` (clause ①, the 2026-09-10 ruling 「必须 fable的还包括对外发布的skills」), and one such path closes the downgrade exit for the whole card, so one dev at that tier builds both PRs. The default flip widens what a view that declares nothing offers: the contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` is owed before PR 1 enqueues; PR 2's `skills/**` hunk is reviewed at that tier as well. (Corrected by the seat at 2026-10-10T05:36Z: this line first read `model: default tier`.)
Clause-②: no
(Corrected by the seat at 2026-10-10T07:24Z: this line first read `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. A moved default neither widens nor narrows the accept set; the contract review `6095058376` judged the arm wrong, and the breaking signal rides the changeset banner and the ADR-0087 marker.)
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card` (a ruled change, filing gate ②)
Thread-read: 6093968052
Serial constraints cleared: the file lists of the open PRs, read at 2026-10-10T05:33Z; none touches `view.zod.ts`, `skills/objectstack-ui/**` or `references/ui/view.mdx`. The other `area:records` cards in flight (#22568 `domain:spec`, #22566 and #22510 `domain:services`) name none of these files. #22568 shares only `registry.ts` (ordinary concurrency; the maintainer's temporary rule-A relaxation applies).

**The ruling, verbatim** (the director seat's filing): 「乙 v18 把 spec 默认翻成 true,editInline: false 变成关法。」 Triage (`6093968052`) graded it `priority:p1`: the default flips on the v18 line, so it must ride the v18 release.

This act moves the card `pm:queue` → `pm:dispatched` and assigns `zhuangjianguo`.

**Why urgent:** PR #22630 merged first (`f368b7e980`). Until this PR lands, the published skill teaches that inline editing is on by default while the spec still parses an absent `editInline` to `false`. The skills catalog installs straight from this repository.

**The three changes, and nothing else:**
1. **`Clause-②: no`**, not `yes (widening)`. A moved default neither widens nor narrows the accept set, and the breaking signal is the changeset banner plus the ADR-0087 marker. Change it in `.changeset/22605-spec-list-view-edit-inline-default-on.md` (line 13). The seat corrects the claim (done, `6094254055`) and the PR body's line 2 (in this act).
2. **`Test Core (4/6)` red, caused by this PR:** `packages/cli/test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts:417`, "`list-view-edit-inline-default-on`: the printed guidance cites a tracker id: expected '#5144' to be undefined".
   - The D3 entry's printed `reason` contains `objectui#5144`.
   - Rewrite that sentence with no tracker number, for example "the one-vocabulary rule objectui ruled for the fold". The 12 `objectui#N` citations among `main`'s semantic entries all sit in `//` comments, never in printed strings, so a citation that must stay belongs in the file's leading comment.
   - Check `surface`, `replacement` and `acceptanceCriteria` for the same.
